dedupe_keys.name: shake table tests on nonlinear steel fuses for the acceleration control of nonstructural components

description: Shake table tests on nonlinear steel fuses for the acceleration-control of nonstructural components is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ahmed Elkady, University of Southampton (southampton.ac.uk). A series of shake table tests exploring the concept of using of nonlinear/ductile steel fuses to reduce the acceleration demands on non-structural components during earthquakes. The tests took place at the EQUALS laboratory in University of Bristol. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 9 top-level files (TXT, PNG, PDF, MP4). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-zhmm-2p82. Keywords: Nonstructural components, Acceleration-sensitive, Floor spectra, Dynamic amplification, Structural fuse, Component nonlinearity. Published 2025-03-24. Facility named: University of Bristol's Earthquake and Large Structures (EQUALS) laboratory. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
